title: ExecutionRequestV1
description: Public execution contract, version runner.execution.v1. This is the only payload an external Test Authoring / IR Generation service needs in order to run a browser test. No source-code dependency on the Runner is required.

contractVersion.description: Rejected with CONTRACT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED if the Runner does not support it.

requestId.description: Caller-side correlation id, echoed in every result and event.

tenantRef.description: Opaque tenant identifier owned by the calling service. The Runner never interprets it.

workspaceRef.description: Opaque workspace identifier. Scopes the Registry and all authorization checks.

externalTestCaseRef.description: Opaque reference to the caller's test case, e.g. a Jira/Xray key.

authProfileRef.description: Runner-owned execution profile. Credentials are referenced, never inlined.

mode.description: AUTO runs unattended; REVIEW pauses on uncertain resolutions; INTERACTIVE is user-driven.

callback.description: Optional webhook delivery. Callers may equally poll the status endpoint or consume the realtime event stream.
